method: Direct centred-window crop (no resampling) from the native-resolution PGDA average-solar-illumination raster at full resolution; pixel values are the raw int16 * scale + offset fraction in [0,1], rendered as a continuous percentage ramp. Multi-year average: an 18.6-year lunar nutation cycle at hourly timestep (PGDA products/69, Mazarico et al. 2011).
nodata_encoding: fully transparent alpha channel (RGBA PNG); never encoded as a visible class or value

source.citation: Mazarico, E., et al. (2011), Icarus, Vol. 211, pp. 1066-1081, doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2010.10.030
source.name: Average solar illumination, 85S-90S, 60 m/px
source.value_meaning: fraction of time illuminated by the Sun, in [0, 1], averaged hourly over an 18.6-year lunar nutation cycle (centred ~2016-08 per filename)
